csrf_token.description: Per-session token; send as X-DLTOOL-CSRF on cookie-authenticated mutations

location.description: Where the error occurred, e.g. 'body.items[3].tags' or 'path.thing-id'

value.description: The value at the given location

detail.description: A human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence of the problem.
examples: Property foo is required but is missing.

errors.description: Optional list of individual error details

instance.description: A URI reference that identifies the specific occurrence of the problem.

title.description: A short, human-readable summary of the problem type. This value should not change between occurrences of the error.

type.description: A URI reference to human-readable documentation for the error.

setup_token.description: The one-time token printed at first boot

version.description: Build version of the dl-tool process

enabled.description: Whether the account may log in

last_login_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the last successful login

bearerToken.description: An API token issued by the account settings; bearer requests are exempt from CSRF.

sessionCookie.description: The dltool_session cookie issued by POST /auth/setup and POST /auth/login; mutations also need the X-DLTOOL-CSRF header.
sessionCookie.name: dltool_session

post.description: Returns the session cookie and the per-session CSRF token.

schema.description: no-store; the body carries the CSRF token

post.summary: Start a session with username and password

post.description: Deletes the server-side session row and expires the cookie; a bearer call has no session to delete and does not revoke the token. Cookie-authenticated calls must send X-DLTOOL-CSRF.

schema.description: The expired session cookie; absent for bearer authentication

get.description: What the SPA calls on boot to choose between the setup wizard, the login screen and the app shell. With bearer authentication the csrf_token is empty.

schema.description: no-store; the body carries the CSRF token

get.summary: Read the caller's account and CSRF token

post.description: Callable only while the operator account does not exist. Every other endpoint answers 401 /problems/setup-required until it succeeds.

schema.description: no-store; the body carries the CSRF token

post.summary: Create the operator account with the one-time setup token
